source_selection: Same public change as the existing bounded-guard experiment; no new representative-sampling claim.
frappe_selection: Latest develop commit returned by GitHub commits API before 2026-08-13T11:00:00Z; selected for temporal compatibility, then pinned.
fixture: Unmodified upstream helper-generated Purchase Order qty=2/rate=100, two receipts qty=1, first return, order closure, second return, cancel second return, ordinary receipt negative control.
execution: Real MariaDB and Redis, unmodified app/controller/test source, single upstream unittest selected by external harness. No web server/browser needed.
trace: Python tracing observes call/return/exception and already materialized document attributes only; no guard mocks, replacement predicates, or additional database reads.
database_control: Restore same initialized test-site SQL snapshot before second source-version run; clear only isolated Redis cache.
expected_before: One test errors at closed-return validation with InvalidStatusError; affected return must not reach update_ordered_and_reserved_qty.
expected_after: One test passes; closed-return submit and cancel reach update_ordered_and_reserved_qty; ordinary closed-order receipt remains rejected.
non_claims: No runtime prevalence or real customer deployment
No assertion that every state in the former six-state Cartesian guard domain is workflow-reachable
No implemented customer receipt logging or production retention policy
No need for retrospective rule application inferred
isolation: Dedicated Docker network and three uniquely named containers, no published ports, generated test database only, public test password constants.
dependency_policy: Container image digests, exact Git revisions, full Python freeze and non-editable package lock retained.
plan_note: Protocol written after source inspection and installation, before selected upstream regression was successfully discovered/executed. An initial light-mode discovery attempt failed while importing unrelated tests; retained in setup_attempts. Not externally preregistered.
